description: They have the record, the process and the lawyers. You have a memory of a phone call and a reference number that may not resolve.
energy_note: Arguing with an institution from memory.

aspect: You find out at the worst moment
description: Errors surface when they matter - at a border, a mortgage application, a hospital, a renewal - which is when you have least ability to stop and fix them.

aspect: SCENARIO - the default that was not his
description: A default appears for a phone contract in a town he has never lived in. The dispute process takes thirty days. The mortgage offer expires in twenty-one.
A correction is a correction. There is no mechanism to reimburse the forty hours and six weeks of anxiety it took to obtain.

aspect: The correction is itself a flag
description: A file that changed is read by later reviewers as unstable, so being wronged leaves a small permanent mark.
